name: Camera request
about: Ask for a camera to be added to the catalog (or offer to add one)

**Camera:** vendor, model, lens (focal length, f-number), sensor resolution

**Where it is used:** robot / application

**Data available:** datasheet link, lens prescription, calibration of a unit, sample captures

**Will you contribute the entry?** yes / no / need help
